svg.title: Cadet Honor Society member of high distinction (the shoulder cord with a gold aiguillette)
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"cord-fl-honor-society-high-distinction","name":"Cadet Honor Society member of high distinction (the shoulder cord with a gold aiguillette)","size_in":{"w":5.17,"h":5.54},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,517,554],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Not dimensioned in CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903. Two existing pieces in one asset. (1) The shoulder cord as drawn by this file for the other cords (the shared spine: 4.1 in long, 0.25 in bow toward the body; 0.48 in across here, 0.5 in on the plain pictures, so that its right edge stays inside the box), the braid of the CAP honor guard uniform guidance figures (base-art/cord-braid.js), standing on the arm side (right) with its neck end level with the tops of the aiguillette's braids. (2) The aiguillette as worn (LIVE9-ART 2), unchanged in shape: drawn from a USAF service dress coat (assets/cords/ref/aiguillette-worn-usaf-service-dress-screenshot.jpg, README), in braid thicknesses B (0.30 in here): two braids leaving the epaulet at the top (cut square here: the ends go under it) side by side, 0.9 B apart: the inner one makes a short loop (legs 2.24 B apart, bottom 10.0 B below the epaulet edge), the outer one a long loop (legs 4.14 B apart, bottom 15.2 B as photographed), each turning up on the chest side into a free end 3.9 B below the epaulet edge; from each free end a thin cord (0.14 B) runs to a whipping (0.7 x 1.8 B at 6.7 B) and on to a pencil tip 3.2 B long (0.96 in at B 0.30), the two tips 0.8 B apart ending 14.7 B below the epaulet edge. B was read on the photo (about 50 px at x4 of the 314 x 236 px preview); every depth and width is read in B from the same picture. How the loops hang is as photographed, a mannequin. The aiguillette's braids are drawn with the same braid function as the shoulder cord (they were a dashed-groove stroke).","provenance":"in-house: the shoulder cord (the braid of the CAP honor guard uniform guidance figures, base-art/cord-braid.js) and the aiguillette (DAFI 36-2903 10.7.7.1: \"silver, single loop, chrome tip with raised wing and star emblem\";
